title: Branches
description: Staging copies of this app with their own URL, data and secrets. Switch sends new traffic and the queue to a branch's build while the old version finishes its work.
emptyDescription: Create one with 21ci branch create. It appears here with its URL and build.
notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted or you lack access.
switchHint: Data and secrets do not move: the new code runs on this app's data and secrets. A rollback does not undo data it wrote.
preflightError: The check could not finish, so nothing changed.

preflight.heading: Before you switch
preflight.running: Tasks still running on the live version
preflight.envMissing: Env and secret names this app lacks
preflight.triggers: Trigger settings that differ and stay as they are on this app
preflight.closeSockets: Close open WebSockets once the new version is live

warning.routes_refresh_delayed: The new version is committed and reaches traffic once the node re-reads its routes.
warning.schedule_tick_skipped: A schedule may skip one tick while an old run finishes.

progress.heading: Progress
progress.interrupted: The node restarted during this switch.

rollbackDescription: Version {{version}} becomes live again. Data written by the newer version stays.
